how: Read by Claude off the frames, Oct 22 2026: the scoreboard every 10 s, the goal banners at each goal, and the demolition at 2:00. The player's own car is the red one the camera follows; orange won 3-1.

points.how: FORKY JR. SCORED! banner at 4:45; score 3-1

kills.what: the player demolishes an opponent: DEMOLITION banner at 2:02, the player drives on

notes: Rocket League has no deaths; a demolition of the player would be one, and none was seen. The only loss of the player's side is the 4:15 goal.
near_deaths_how: Rocket League has no health, so no near-deaths.
